title: About Me
content:
Front End developer with over 15 years of professional experience, based in Aracaju/SE. Vasco’s fan, from Bahia and brazilian from heart.

I was born and raised in Itabuna, a city in Bahia. When I were a child, I always dreamed of becoming an civil engineer, though I occasionally considered becoming a veterinarian. My mother wished for me to pursue a career in nursing, and over time, I thought about study in economics, management, or mathematics. However, my passion alwayes computer science, which I ultimately chose to study at university.

In April 2010, I graduated in Information Systems and moved to Rio de Janeiro, where I worked as a Front End Developer at ZONAInternet agency until November 2012.

From December 2012 to October 2020, I had a great experience working as a Front End Developer at CENPES/Petrobras. After that, from November 2020 to March 2025, I thoroughly enjoyed working remotely as a developer at LAMCSO/COPPE/UFRJ.

Currently, I live in Aracaju, SE, and my new goals are focused on working remotely as a developer with the LCCV/UFAL development team.
